General Practitioner
Park Ville

22.08.2020

Re: Mrs Karen Jackson, aged 36 years

Dear Dr Desai,

I am writing to refer Mrs Jackson, who has been a patient of mine for ten years, into your care.
They are now moving to Park Ville; thus, I would be grateful if you could furtherly manage her       Commented [DSM1]: She is
anxiety.

Mrs Jackson is a married hairdresser salon manager. After two first trimester-miscarriages, she      Commented [t2]: first-trimester miscarriages
managed to have a daughter, now 28-month-old. She does not smoke, and she does not [or] drink        Commented [t3]: 28 months old
alcohol during pregnancy. Additionally, she participates in recreational sports. [Avoid ultrashort
                                                                                                     Commented [DSM4]: did not
sentences]
                                                                                                     Commented [DSM5]: did

After delivering the first baby, Mrs Jackson had mild anxiety for which she refused to take
medications as she was lactating. Anxiety improved when the baby started to sleep regularly.

In August 2020, Mrs Jackson presented with similar anxiety as she was planning to get pregnant.
Medications and lifestyle modifications were rejected. Today, the condition has worsened.
[ultrashort sentence] Moving to Park Ville and the fear of losing work, family, and friends
increased her anxiety. Poor sleep and appetite were reported. [ultrashort sentence]

The current pregnancy is progressing well. [ultrashort sentence] Mrs Jackson is receiving
multivitamins to prevent miscarriage. [ultrashort sentence] Her request for home delivery is not
recommended as she had gestational diabetes and required forceps delivery in her first pregnancy.

Follow-up on Mrs Jackson’s pregnancy and addressing her anxiety would be appreciated. If you
have any queries, please contact me.

Yours sincerely,
Doctor
